description: JEXI OS Phase 7(B) hook metadata — id, human description, and content fingerprint (sha256 of the script file, first 16 hex). A fingerprint change means the hook's bytes changed.

hooks.description: Blocks `npm run dev` and equivalent dev-server launches outside tmux (exit 2 → tool call denied). Allow path: inside tmux / TMUX set.
Warn-only reminder for long-running commands (sleep/watch/tail -f/dev servers): suggests tmux so the process survives disconnects.
Warn-only reminder before `git push`: review staged diff, outgoing commits, and working tree before shipping.
Blocks `git commit` when staged .js files fail node --check or repo ESLint error rules (server/eslint.config.js). Warn/fail-open on lint tooling failure.
Stop event (turn/mission end): appends a JSONL evaluation verdict to hooks/state/session-evals.jsonl.
SessionStart: restores prior session memory from hooks/state/<sid>.memory.json when present; announces fresh session otherwise.
PreCompact: writes hooks/state/<sid>.checkpoint.json recording the conversation about to be compacted.
SessionEnd: persists hooks/state/<sid>.memory.json so a later SessionStart can restore context.
